title: Tide times on the berth page
ask: Approve the design for tide times on the berth page before anyone plans the build.

product.problem: Sailors leave the marina app to look up the tide, and some miss the window to clear the harbour bar.

users.need: Sees the next high and low tide on the page for their berth.

goals: A sailor reads the next two tides without leaving the berth page.

nonGoals.why: A later design, once sailors use the times.

requirements.title: Next tides on the berth page
requirements.text: The berth page shows the next high and low tide for the harbour, with their times and heights.

endpoints.answers: The next high and low tide at the harbour the berth is in.

who.text: Anyone signed in to the marina app

outcomes.when: The harbour has a tide table for today.
outcomes.title: Tides
